name: Once
description: The series revolves around Gabo, a soccer-loving teenager who, upon receiving a scholarship from the prestigious Sports Academic Institute (IAD) of Buenos Aires, will see his dream of playing at Los Halcones Dorados, the renowned amateur team of the school, and also his longing to become a professional footballer.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Felipe and Gabo live in a small village near Buenos Aires and dream of a football career. One day, Señor Vitto, a representative of a football academy, appears and has to decide whom he will offer a scholarship to.

videos.title: Una mal bienvenida, una pasión
videos.overview: After arriving at the academy, Gabo immediately becomes friends with his roommates Ricky and Dedé. However, he defeated just the record holder Lorenzo in a penalty, which will turn out to be a big mistake.

videos.title: Un nuevo equipo, una pasión
videos.overview: The starting signal for a fierce power struggle between Lorenzo and Gabo has fallen. However, Gabo has not only to defend himself against Lorenzo's lousy tricks, but also against his father Diego, who was appointed the new sports director.

videos.title: Un mal rendimiento, una pasión parte 1
videos.overview: Gabo struggles to get his performance up in training - a godsend for Diego, who wants to shut him out of the IAD and deny him the scholarship. It quickly comes to suspicion that things are not right here.

videos.title: Un mal rendimiento, una pasión parte 2
videos.overview: In order to clear Lorenzo's biggest competitor, Lorenzo's father Diego tries to deprive Gabo of the scholarship due to a lack of achievements. Gabo is worried that he has to go back to his village now when Zoe and he approach.

videos.title: Un examen, una pasión
videos.overview: Lorenzo and Gabo compete for the post of team captain. When Francesco and Diego agree to include school performance as well, Lorenzo's chances rise, unlike Gabos.

videos.title: ¡No quiero ser capitán!, una pasión
videos.overview: The math test, which makes a decisive contribution to the team captain, creates great tension. Although Lorenzo is in front in all areas, Gabo is well on his way to catch up.

videos.title: Entrenamiento extra, una pasión
videos.overview: Martina decides to help Gabo with the math exam, which causes great mistrust among his friends. Meanwhile, Lorenzo doesn't miss an opportunity to bully Gabo and let him know he's the better player.

videos.title: Calificación del examen, una pasión
videos.overview: Ironically, Gabo and Lorenzo have to play in a team, which Lorenzo doesn't like at all. Professor Olson's attempt to show the children a rare snake ends in hallucinations and a visit to the infirmary.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Gabo is horrified by the result of the math test, but he can prove that things are not right. Meanwhile, Martina becomes captain, and Zoe becomes a regular player in the volleyball team.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Lorenzo tries to pull Mariano and Catorce for the captain's election on his side. But the choice is different than expected. Diego's promising offer of an agency meets with skepticism. Gabo gets the offer of his life.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Gabo has reservations about accepting the offer to play in Europe. While the Hawks prepare for a game against a professional team, Lorenzo tries to attach Gabo to the theft of the most important trophy of the IAD.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Gabo is still suspected of stealing the trophy, pushing him ever closer to Giovanni's arms. While Dedé and Ricky try to prove his innocence, Lorenzo leaves no stone unturned to uphold the allegations.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: An anonymous letter assures Gabo's innocence, whereupon Isabel has a new suspicion. Meanwhile, Lorenzo worries about the trophy, which was stolen from Camilo's bag. The meeting on the professional team is different than expected.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Valentino has to leave the game, whereupon Lorenzo becomes the new captain. Ricky believes he has seen the trophy and goes in search of the half-time. Since the game is going badly for the Hawks, Diego offers Francisco a bet.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The Hawks have won the game. When Lorenzo suddenly shows team spirit and makes peace with Gabo, he is elected as the new captain. Gabo decides against the offer as a professional player. A video about the institute causes confusion.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The manipulated video does not only cause irritation to the Ministry of Education. Lorenzo's plan to ban Ricky on the bench takes a turn when the real culprit betrays himself by a gross mistake.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Ricky tries to convict Camilo of the crime before he himself will be wrongly accused. While Francisco is dissatisfied with the lineup for the game against the Eagles, these provoke the Hawks. Diego is planning the victory of the first game.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: While Ricky finds nothing on Camilo's tablet, Camilo suspects that his tablet has been replaced. One last idea from Ricky is to ask Amadeo for help. Through Ricky's suspension, Lorenzo's plan of playmaking goes up.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Although Amadeo has found proof of Camilo's guilt, Lorenzo's betrayal leads him to the director. Due to the expulsion of Camilo from the IAD, the team must be restructured shortly before the game - with serious consequences.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: After the Hawks have lost the game against the Eagles, they have to endure much scorn and ridicule. Diego is trying to find a substitute for Coach Francisco, who has to make a tough decision on Gabo's and Lorenzo's future.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Gabo and Lorenzo have to help Florencio clean up, which especially Gabo doesn't like at first. After Ezequiel tries in vain to threaten Gabo, Gabo learns more about his father's pin.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Ricky and Dedé are spurred on by the idea that the pin Gabo found belongs to his father. After Francisco makes an important decision, he receives unexpected support, but he should not be happy too soon.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Ricky and Dedé continue to try to find out who Gabo's biological father is. Meanwhile, Martina rejects every single one of Zoe's ideas and Ricky makes a startling discovery that will not be without consequences for Gabo and Zoe.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Ricky and Dedé tell Gabo about their theory that Francisco can be his father. Now they must do their best to keep Gabo and Zoe apart and elicit information from Zoe on a very specific coin.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: To finally find out if Francisco is his natural father, Gabo asks him about his pin. Vitto and Pulpo follow Giovanni and make a disturbing discovery. Lorenzo has doubts about Franciscos strategy for the next game.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Gabo tries to find out if Zoe is mad at him, while Ricky and Dedé follow Bruno to a spa. After an interview with Gabo on Joaquín's channel, Julián and his team show up there to answer in person.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Vitto considers Francisco's behavior suspicious and is looking for talk with Diego. Dedé gets more and more stressed because of the game. Meanwhile, Lorenzo tries to pressure Dedé to get rid of a player.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Gabo wants to know more about the favor Lorenzo has asked Dedé. Finally, Gabo gets answers to his questions, whereupon he asks Zoe for advice. Joaquín participates in a major competition broadcast on television.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Due to tensions between the Hawks and their opponents, the Hawks are struggling to keep up with their opponents in the field. Meanwhile, Joaquín can once again shine on television with his football knowledge.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Dedé is getting more stressed because of the upcoming game. In addition, Lorenzo begins to pressure him to get rid of one of the players. While Vitto pursues a suspect, Zoe and Martina begin to argue.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Vitto and Pulpo learn more about the spy, who's after them while Gabo, Ricky and Dedé try to find out more about the medal. After Catorce's appointment as the fastest player, some players fear for their position.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: The team suspects it will be spied on by Gabo, Ricky and Dedé. Gabo confirms this suspicion and urges the team to find out who is behind it. Meanwhile, Diego spins more intrigues to cause quarrels and unrest.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Ricky worries about his place in the team. Gabo and Lorenzo try to find out who shares information about the Hawks. Meanwhile, Francisco confronts Giovanni and learns about the alumni meeting.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Gabo, Ricky and Dedé continue to work on organizing Dora's party, but this time with Dora herself on board. Eventually, Diego finds a suitable scapegoat to blame on spying on the Hawk.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: It succeeds Gabo, Rocky and Dedé to bring together Dora with their former students and narrow the circle of suspects a piece. To finally have more success with the girls, Lucas decides to undergo a complete renewal.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Out of anger to be just a substitute, Ricky makes a bad decision. Dedé is pursuing a plan that could have serious consequences, especially for him. Vitto and Pulpo are still convinced that Florencio spies on the team.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Gabo is still suffering from the serious consequences of Ricky's actions against him. Meanwhile Ezequiel arouses the suspicion that he wants to lose the game to sabotage his team.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Gabo finds out that the cause of his pain is not the supposed fracture, causing Vitto to show Amadeo Gabo's x-rays. Meanwhile, Diego and Francisco can not agree on Gabo's role in the next game.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Rafa and his father have a profound conversation. Although Gabo's ankle still causes pain, he can not be stopped from playing. Will Zoe manage to stop him?

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Gabo injured again on the same ankle. When Ricky and Dedé visit him in the hospital, the completely exhausted Dedé almost falls asleep on a couch in the hallway.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Francisco gives up his position as team coach, after which Diego proposes Vitto as a substitute. Meanwhile, Amelia learns more about the true extent of Gabo's injury and makes a decision.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Gabo still does not know if he can stay at the school, but tries to move Francisco back to the IAD at the same time as Pulpo.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Diego asks Gabo to slow down his recovery process. Hoping to find Gabo's father, Ricky and Dedé go to another club.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: As part of their research on Gabo's father, Ricky and Dedé participate in the trial training of a foreign football club. They are watched by Joaquín and finally accused of betrayal.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Isabel insists that Gabo will be examined by a doctor before a final decision is made. Vitto realizes that he was wrong about Diego and suspects that he may be the Institute's spy.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Gabo is finally allowed to participate in the training again. Lorenzo, however, can not refrain from venting Gabo's secret and does not shy away from extorting Zoe.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Gabo learns that Zoe has talked to Lorenzo about him and feels betrayed. Hoping to cheer up Gabo, Zoe and Joaquín decide to make a video about Francisco and the Hawks.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: While Vitto continues to blame his late registration, Diego and Isabel are trying to find a solution to the problem. Vitto overrides Diego's instructions, which has dire consequences for Gabo.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Francisco decides to stop working for the IAD, but Vitto wants to prove that Diego hides his true identity. Martina finds out that Gabo could be related to Lorenzo.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Lorenzo finds a photo in Gabo's room that irritates him so much that he plays very badly. Diego persuades Francesco to give him tips for the game. Then Catorce has a great match. Lorenzo makes a far-reaching decision.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Diego uses his success to extend Vitto's suspension. Facundo becomes provisional coach of the Hawks. Gabo is finally allowed to train with the team again. Lorenzo tries in vain to talk to his father.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Facundo, the new coach of the Hawks, strikes a harder note and excludes Lorenzo due to his behavior from training. Dedé has a new idea how to find Gabo's father.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: The hawks are worried. Francisco has received a tempting coaching offer from Colombia. Martina and Lorenzo spy on Ricky, Gabo and Dedé. They also want to convince Gabo that the late Dario López was his father.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Ricky, Gabo and Dedé find the cell phone with which they are overheard. Zoe tries to stop her father from taking on the job in Colombia.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Francisco and Vitto come back to the IAD. Gabo shows a very poor performance in training, something seems to occupy him. A virus paralyzes the computer system of the IAD and heralds the day of revenge.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: The IAD is still offline after the cyberattack. Joaquín and Catorce research for a report about it and hope to find the cause of the disturbance. Martina and Lorenzo are worried about whether their plan will work without the Internet.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Vitto is convinced that Diego is behind the hacker attack on the IAD, he collects evidence for it. At the same time he tries to get the team fit for the next game - and everything offline. Gabo thinks he knows who his father is.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Diego wants to exclude Gabo from the training of the Hawks, in order not to provoke the commission by the late registration. Vitto informs Gabo about the decision, who reacts in dismay and despair.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: The deciding game of the Hawks against the Samurai is imminent. Lorenzo and Martina continue to pursue their wrong game and Diego does everything to keep the IAD offline. Gabo has to live with the news that his putative father is dead.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: The Hawks are happy about their last success. Ricky fulfills his promise to be Dedé's assistant for one day. Joaquín and Catorce find a sponsor. The boys claim that Camilo sabotaged the system and question him.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: The boys want to convince Camilo to restore the computer system in the IAD. Diego and Giovanni have a plan to free them from the suspicion of espionage. Francisco and Vitto want to prevent Valentino from leaving the team.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: The Hawks forge a plan to trick Camilo. Francisco asks Pulpo to join the team to help with goalkeeper training. Lorenzo might feel compelled to make a hard decision.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Catorce's date with Celeste is terribly wrong. Meanwhile, the team tries to circumvent Camilo's conditions. Gabo and his friends hope for Joaquín's help.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Camilo threatens to completely shut down the system if Lorenzo does not meet his demands. The boys turn Bruno on to check the security. Martina wants to prevent Lorenzo from telling Gabo the truth about his father.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Gabo starts pursuing Lorenzo to get an answer from him. Ricky and Dedé help out for a day in the cafeteria. Camilo and Ezequiel continue to intrigue against the Hawks.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Lorenzo offers his help to Gabo. Pulpo is forced to decide what he wants to do. Camilo and Ezequiel continue to make plans to bring down the Hawks.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Lucas and Leo are about to unravel the mystery of Ludmila. Gabo is suspicious of Giovanni's meeting with Camilo and Ezequiel. Dedé is still looking for his lucky stockings. Giovanni makes contact with someone who is very close to Gabo.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Pulpo calls Valentino the reason why he leaves the team of supervisors. Valentino and Rafa continue to argue. Zoe tries to find a way to change Dede's attitude while helping JoacoSports. Ricky secretly trains for the freestyle competition.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Felipe insists that Gabo leaves. This leads to a dispute between the two. Ricky continues to try to balance the freestyle competition and the upcoming game. Pulpo is still worrying about the goalkeeper's performance.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Ricky and Daniel have a lot of trouble because they were trapped. Gabo and his friends are worried about where they are. The hawks mercilessly go down in the game. Lorenzo and Gabo are talking.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Francisco punishes Ricky and Daniel for their absence at play. Diego insists on defending Gabo before the Disciplinary Committee. Meanwhile, the relationship between Lorenzo and Gabo is improving.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Jaoquín is looking for a new assistant. Gabo is disappointed with the decision of the committee and is considering accepting Felipe's offer. Camilo's lies support his revenge plans.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Gabo and Lorenzo are facing the exclusion of the IAD. Nevertheless, Francisco allows the two to continue training. Gabo is looking for a direct conversation with the members of the team

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: The truth about Gabo's case finally comes to light, but his fate is still hanging by a thread. Lorenzo is considering his relationship with Gabo. And he'll find out who's really behind Felipe's offer.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Diego changes the plan for his future at the IAD. Ezequiel confronts Camilo with his plan to take Lorenzo and Gabo out of the tournament. Diego and Francisco are talking. Gabo gives an interview to an unknown reporter.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Joaquín is angry that Gabo gave an interview. Gabo and his friends follow Lorenzo's group and find out what they do in the afternoons. Julia has some news for Gabo.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Gabo is very disturbed by the news about his father. Lorenzo tells Martina that he will stop keeping secrets from Gabo. The chances of victory are dwindling day by day.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Olson holds an oral exam to give students the opportunity to participate in the game. But not everyone can pass the test, so they can not change players in the match.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: The decisive game presents the Hawks with special challenges. The positive development between Gabo and Lorenzo is also evident in their interaction.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Hawks are celebrating great news. Gabo gets mysterious messages. Diego is unmasked. Lorenzo makes a decision regarding his relationship with Gabo. A drone follows the friends.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The boys get the Colombian classmate Martín Mejía, who turns out to be a nuisance. Lorenzo tells Diego that he already knows that he is also Gabo's father.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: A very special, new student is coming. Also, there are strange video messages. Diego complicates the situation of the school. Lorenzo challenges his father and reveals a secret.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Diego and Gabo confront each other with their personal connection. Isabel and Francisco are looking for a solution to the financial problems. Francisco and Vitto are struggling with the complications of their new posts.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Gabo realizes that the messages he receives are not advertising, but something mysterious. Joaquín interviews the Machetes. Félix suspends Ezequiel from training.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Joaquín informs the Hawks of their next opponents - the Guards. Diego wants to grab the IAD and forces Isabel to decide between two evils. Ezequiel comes to training, but Félix doesn't want to see him there.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Gabo has to retake the ball to pass the mysterious test. Francisco faces the decision to bring Ezequiel back into the Hawks team. Diego deletes the volleyball group's journey and the girls demand an explanation.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Zoe is disappointed and angry at Gabo's behavior. Ezequiel returns to the Hawks. When Gabo and Diego drive to the airport to pick up the guards, Gabo wants to persuade Diego to reconsider his decision regarding the volleyball team.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Adrián installs a camera at the football field so that the Hawks can watch what happens there, but the Guards beat them. Ezequiel starts training with the Hawks and shows what he can do.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Diego announces that the Hawks can drop out of school hours to focus on the sport. In addition, he forbids Joaquín to transfer the upcoming game against the Guards - for dubious reasons.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Diego suspended Zoe and Joaquín for the transfer of the game. When Joaquín still comes to school, he overhears Diego and tells the team what he has heard. When Diego meets Joaquín at school, it's a bit of a scandal.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Even though Isabel is the director of the IAD again and things are normalizing, the problems do not stop. A new player joins the Hawks and the guys are not very happy about that. Diego is working on a plan to regain the upper hand.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: While Isabel tries to iron out the problems that Diego has caused the IAD, he meets Félix to make him an offer. Dedé remains nervous about the upcoming flight and everyone worries about him. The boys continue to receive mysterious videos.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Gabo realizes his feelings as he sees Ezequiel approach Zoe. Félix has good and bad news for Diego. Giovanni and Diego comment. While the group tries to decode the news of the mysterious videos, Martín wants to know what they are doing.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: The group decrypts a task. Meanwhile, Joaquín is looking for a way to cover travel expenses to report on the Intercup. Without telling his friends about it, Gabo does the DNA test with Diego. Diego, Giovanni and Félix conspire.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Diego announces to Gabo and Lorenzo that he will become the new sports director of the Eagles. Joaquín's crowdfunding is not progressing as fast as he expected, and Zoe advises him to team up with Catorce.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The day before the trip, Francisco releases the team so that the youngsters can enjoy themselves. Meanwhile, the Eagles use new sensors for their training, but have no one who can operate it. Joaquín receives good and bad news.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Dedé can not be found and the team is on the way. Vitto offers to travel with the rest of the group the next day. Amadeo does not accept Diego's suggestion, whereupon Diego gets angry. Julián is considering playing for the Eagles.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Gabo, Ricky and Dedé are worried about the delay of several hours. Vitto promises Francisco that they arrive on time. Isabel tells Francisco a secret. Joaquín has no way of transmitting the match live on his channel.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: The Hawks make it onto the field just as the game begins. Gabo, Ricky and Dedé are watching the game over JoacoSport. The substitution of the three players changes the game completely.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Ricky and Dedé are very reserved towards Gabo. Francisco and Isabell bring in a specialist to treat Dedé and he has no choice but to accept that. Catorce pretends to be someone else because he's in love. Zoe defends Gabo.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Francisco and Isabel comment on the incident with the trophy. Gabo is not satisfied with Isabel's decision. Martina and Silvia start a joke against Joaquín, but Celeste notices and prevents it. The mood in the cabin of the Hawks is hostile.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: The mood around Martín remains tense. Lorenzo calls Gabo, who tells him his decision. Joaquín and Celeste have a plan. Gabo tells Lorenzo about the bad news. Zoe decides to confront Ricky and Dedé and the three remain worried.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Diego offers money to Gabo to cover his scholarship. When Gabo refuses, Diego decides to involve Amelia in his plan. Zoe and the boys don't know how to deal with Gabo. Zoe mediates between the guys.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: The group tries to master the difficult exam. Amelia talks to Gabo to persuade him to live with his father. Martín spreads intrigues between the friends of Gabo and the friends of Lorenzo.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Gabo begins life with his father and wonders about his behavior. The young people plan to help the Machetes with their equipment, even if not everyone agrees. The boys are surprised by the newly formed team of the Eagles.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Gabo is bothered that Zoe distrusts his father. Zoe wants to know if Ezequiel has agreed to his move to the Eagles. Gabo realizes that he is still a bit oppressed and Lorenzo encourages him.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Gabo doesn't want to cause Zoe any problems. Lorenzo tells Adrián and Pablo that his revenge plan is already up and running. The Zorros de Plata arrive at the IAD. Martín apologizes to Gabo, but he doesn't accept that.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: The mood between Lorenzo, Gabo and Diego is very tense. Ricky and Dedé tell Gabo that Martín knows about his father, but Gabo isn't worried. Gabo tells them that Olivia has not changed the day of the exam for him.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Martín suspects a connection between Lorenzo, Martina and the photos found in Julia's house. Martina is afraid he'll find out what they did. Joaquín transfers the game between the Hawks and the Silver Foxes.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Gabo doesn't agree with Lorenzo's idea of switching to the Eagles. Gabo asks Isabel for help because of his grandmother's birthday. Martín tells Ricky and Dedé what he has learned in conversation with Julia.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Ricky and Dedé ask Martín for help proving that Martina was in Julia's house. Ezequiel feels bad to be a substitute, but Zoe calms him down. Martina receives a message on her mobile phone. Lorenzo wants to confront Martín.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Abril tells Gabo, Ricky and Dedé that they are out of the game if they don't master the challenge. Gabo talks to Lorenzo about the challenge. Martina talks to her mother about the punishment for entering a strange house.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Gabo asks Martín why he owns a hidden phone and believes his lie. Lucas participates in the mascot casting, unsettling Joaquín, Catorce and Celeste. Gabo and Lorenzo receive the same message about a challenge.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: The group wins the challenge. Martín asks Ricky and Dedé if they will continue with the plan. Gabo, Ricky and Dedé talk about the bonus reward. Gabo meets Ezequiel and Amadeo as they talk about programming.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Lorenzo and Martina are confused when it is confirmed that Martín is not sending the messages. Dedé has Martín's mobile phone. Gabo and Lorenzo go home to Diego with Amelia's gift. Lorenzo is worried about losing his brother.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Martina tells Gabo the truth about the photo. She informs Martín that she has already spoken to Gabo. As Amelia drives away, Gabo confronts Lorenzo. Lorenzo and Martina argue and part. Gabo tells Zoe what happened.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Gabo warns Lorenzo that he will talk to Diego if Lorenzo does not do it himself. Martín is glad that his plan works. Dedé suspects Martín and Ricky feels bad that he helped him. Zoe tells Gabo what happened to Martina and the second mobile phone.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: The team is stunned by Gabo's warning that he will not play if Lorenzo plays. The Hawks compete without Gabo. Finally, Francisco prevails and Gabo is still on the field. Gabo plays selfish and harms the team.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: His family and friends are worried about Gabo's untypical behavior during the game and his general mood. Gabo feels the rejection of others. Lorenzo tries to apologize to Gabo. Francisco helps Lorenzo and makes a decision.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Toni receives the three teenagers and tells them about a game, which they lose because they don't know the rules. Diego visits Lorenzo with Francisco and tells him that he can't come back until everything is clarified with Gabo.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Everyone is surprised by Ricky's behavior. Martina tells Lorenzo that Martín has sent the news. Zoe tells the others that Martina designed the plan for Lorenzo. Adrián hears that and tells the team.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Gabo shows understanding for Ricky's act, but Dedé feels cheated by Ricky. Lucas wants to find out the identity of the mascot and spies on Isabel all day. Zoe asks Gabo to talk to Lorenzo. Gabo talks to him, but don't forgive him.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: Gabo asks Diego to stop Lorenzo from traveling to Mexico. Gabo talks to Lorenzo, who tells him that his decision is certain. Dedé and Ricky make peace. Isabel notes that Lucas filmed her.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Gabo, Ricky and Dedé play the opening game against Max, Bulldog and Dina and try to score with their tactics, but the rules of the game are changing, they have to play without light. Camilo calls Martín and agrees with the plan against Julián.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Julián is taken to the hospital. Lucas confronts Pelosi with being the mascot and Pelosi thinks of a punishment for Adrián and Pablo. Diego asks Ezequiel to find out what happened to Julián.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Diego explains to Gabo his suggestion to do him a favor and that he should only help the Eagles during training. Gabo accepts the proposal, but keeps the whole secret. Lorenzo tells his teammates about his plans for Mexico.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: After training with the Eagles, Gabo tells Diego that he feels like a traitor. Lorenzo talks to Francisco about his injury. Florencio accepts a video in which he agrees to be Falco. Martín and Camilo are working on their plan to expel Gabo from the Hawks.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: The event of Joaquín and Catorce was successful, they have reached their donation target. Still, a few members of the Hawks are angry at Gabo's video. Adrián and Lucas are particularly angry and see him as a traitor.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Lorenzo tells Gabo that Diego just manipulates him. The Eagles are preparing for their game against the Machetes. Diego tells them that he will wait for Gabo. Camilo calls Martín and tells him that the plan has failed.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Gabo tells Diego that the IAD is not the place for him. Francisco starts training with Martín. Felipe presents the jerseys to the Machetes. Catorce is convinced that the boys are lying to him. The Eagles lose against the Machetes.

videos.title: Episode 52
